CALIFORNIA DIESEL PRICES HIT RECORD HIGHS

DIESEL PRICES IN CALIFORNIA HAVE SURGED TO RECORD LEVELS, WITH THE STATEWIDE AVERAGE RISING ABOVE $8 A GALLON AND ONE SAN DIEGO STATION CHARGING $9.99.
